# Laravel Image Tools

> Deterministic, query‑driven image generation for Laravel (inspired by vite‑imagetools).
> `ImageTools::asset('img.jpg?w=1200&format=webp')` returns a public URL to a hash‑named
> derivative written to a configured filesystem disk, recording the `path?query → file`
> mapping in a PHP manifest so later calls are cheap.

Key ideas: the query string (`w`, `h`, `fit`, `q`, `format`) is canonicalized — reduced to
those keys and sorted — into a "seed" that yields deterministic filenames and manifest keys.
Generation runs on demand, ahead of time via a scanner command, or deferred to the queue
with a `queue` flag. Works with any Laravel disk (public, S3/R2).

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): installation, usage, query options, deferred (queued) generation, configuration, commands, troubleshooting
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): notable changes and releases
- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md): setup, commands, layout, conventions, and invariants for contributors

## Source

- [ImageTools](src/ImageTools.php): core — `asset()`, `generate()`, canonical seed, manifest, queued dispatch
- [GenerateImageJob](src/Jobs/GenerateImageJob.php): queued generation (`ShouldQueue` + `ShouldBeUnique`)
- [GenerateImagesCommand](src/Commands/GenerateImagesCommand.php): scan Blade/PHP and pre‑generate
- [ClearGeneratedImagesCommand](src/Commands/ClearGeneratedImagesCommand.php): remove generated files and the manifest
- [config](config/image-tools.php): disk, manifest path, scan paths, queue settings
